desc:
☕ Welcome to your little café!

Make cozy drinks and serve sweet treats to customers .  🍪

♡ CONTROLS

PC: Use your mouse to interact with café items.
Mobile: Tap the buttons and items on your screen.

SMALL UPDATE 🥤 
• 🍓 Strawberry & chocolate milkshakes 
• Mint Diner wallpaper
• 🛏️ New cat bed colors

Thank you so much for the support! this game still in development and is solely ran by a college student.  I will try to release updates and fix bugs as often as I can, Sorry if there are any problems! ☕
